scope: Targeted Phase 5 extraction from the official Theros Beyond Death Story Summary (Wizards of the Coast, 2020-01-10), told in third-person narration. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; not owner approved.

claims.subject: theros_gods

quotes.quote: Imbued with incredible power by the faith of mortals, the gods sealed the titans away in the Underworld.

claims.summary: The gods of Theros sealed the titans away in the Underworld.

claims.subject: klothys

quotes.quote: Klothys, the god of fate, volunteered to act as jailer and sequestered herself in the Underworld for eternity.
it was Klothys who acted as eternal seal, ensuring the titans remained trapped

claims.summary: Klothys acts as jailer and eternal seal keeping the titans trapped.

claims.subject: erebos

quotes.quote: While Erebos rules this realm beyond death

claims.summary: Erebos rules the Underworld of Theros.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: The sun god Heliod sent his champion, the Planeswalker Elspeth, to destroy Xenagos—and she succeeded.

claims.summary: As Heliod's champion, Elspeth destroyed the ascended god Xenagos.

claims.subject: heliod

quotes.quote: Fearful, Heliod struck Elspeth down in her moment of triumph, casting her into the Underworld to be forgotten.

claims.summary: Heliod killed Elspeth after her victory and cast her into the Underworld.

quotes.quote: Of Daxos, her former love, whom she was tricked into killing.

claims.subject: daxos

quotes.quote: To that end, he pulled the soul of the oracle Daxos and transformed him into his champion in the mortal realm.

claims.summary: Heliod transformed the oracle Daxos into his demigod champion.

claims.subject: klothys

quotes.quote: So Klothys weaved her masterpiece—an agent of fate she called Calix.

claims.summary: Klothys created Calix as an agent of fate.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: She also clashed repeatedly with Calix, emerging victorious every time.
Still, she defeated him one final time as she reached the exit.

claims.summary: Elspeth repeatedly defeated Calix during her escape.

claims.subject: elspeth_tirel

quotes.quote: Staring down the point of a spear that was no longer his, Heliod yielded.

claims.summary: Heliod yielded to Elspeth when his spear shattered.

claims.subject: erebos

quotes.quote: And Erebos simply took the defeated sun god and placed him beneath a giant boulder

claims.summary: Erebos imprisoned the defeated Heliod beneath a giant boulder.

claims.subject: calix

quotes.quote: Calix headed off in pursuit of Elspeth in order to preserve that which should be.
But in his darkest hour, a strange idea sparked within him—and he simply planeswalked after her.

claims.summary: Calix pursued Elspeth, ultimately planeswalking after her.

claims.subject: ashiok

quotes.quote: Ashiok's visions are more real than most, and in one of them, Elspeth seized Heliod's spear Khrusor.
When the vision had passed, a twisted version of the spear remained, dripping with darkness and power.

claims.summary: The shadowspear came out of one of Ashiok's nightmare visions.
claims.limitation: The summary says the spear remained after Ashiok's vision; calling Ashiok its creator is an inference.

claims.subject: ashiok

quotes.quote: Ashiok learned of the Phyrexians' existence and promptly planeswalked away to learn more of these true living nightmares.

claims.summary: Ashiok left Theros to learn more about the Phyrexians.

remaining: Only the summary page is used; Odds & Ends: Theros Beyond Death and the story-on-cards feature are not yet extracted
